summary: Reads a selected frame from another Cache TOP using a relative cache index.

key_params.name: cachetop
key_params.note: Source Cache TOP to read from

key_params.name: index
key_params.note: Relative index into the source cache

common_gotchas: Cache TOP must be populated; reset or stale caches make valid-looking indices unavailable.
Index is relative to current cached image, not an absolute timeline frame.
Common output resolution or aspect settings can hide the source cache resolution.
Viewer smoothing and filtering can affect visual inspection of cached float textures.
key_concepts: Cache Select TOP reads frames from a named Cache TOP without owning the cache itself.
Index 0 means the current cached image; negative values address older cached images.
The output is only valid when the source Cache TOP contains the requested frame.
This operator is a random-access view into cached GPU frames.
Common TOP output settings can still resize, filter, or reformat the selected frame.
